headline: Retail pressure moved toward value frozen sets, private label and measurable digital grocery; Real Dough needs buyer-ready proof on sourdough differentiation, price justification and digital shelf readiness.

items: Market intel feed is current through 2026-09-04 with five daily reports for ISO week 36.
Frozen food is getting incremental retailer attention: Dollar General reported Q2 net sales up 5.2% to $11.3B, same-store sales up 3.5%, and strong response to its Dollar Door frozen-food set.
Natural and organic channels keep expanding access: Sprouts expects 42 net new stores in 2026, and Natural Grocers added DoorDash delivery across all 174 stores in 22 states.

Hospitality reputation signal remains healthy across the Merriment Social group: Google ratings in data/reviews.json are 4.4 Merriment Social, 4.5 Third Coast Provisions, 4.5 Flourchild Pizza and 4.7 The Loon Room.

Private label is a direct pizza threat: Spins data cited this week says Gen Z and millennials drove 81% of private-label spending gains, and pizza was called out as a category with high young-shopper penetration and low private-label share.
Value grocery is tightening the frozen occasion: Amazon Grocery is advertising 1,000+ private-label products mostly under $5, while Dollar General is expanding value-priced frozen merchandising.

Retailers are raising execution expectations: Kroger added a former Walmart operations/e-commerce executive as chief store operations officer, Dollar General is deploying AI replenishment, and brokers are selling store-level execution visibility.
Ingredient claims need evidence: avocado-oil subpoenas following UC Davis adulteration findings show premium ingredient and seed-oil-free claims are getting more scrutiny.
Build a one-page buyer defense against private label: why Real Dough is worth the shelf price, how sourdough changes quality, and which shopper/occasion it wins.
Audit retailer PDPs and sell sheets for digital grocery readiness: product images, sourdough process, ingredient proof, nutrition, prep time, serving count, UPC/item data and frozen-handling details.

Use agency creative to make the first-frame value obvious: Wisconsin sourdough, premium ingredients, fast at-home meal, better-than-takeout result. Do not claim creative performance until the current analytics source is wired into this repo.
Prepare a concise claim-substantiation file for any clean-label, seed-oil, protein, fiber, origin or sourdough-process claims used in packaging, PDPs, ads and buyer decks.

agency_brief.what_worked: The defensible story is retail-ready differentiation. Frozen doors and delivery access are expanding, but the brands that win will make quality, value and item data easy for buyers, search algorithms and shoppers to understand.
agency_brief.what_didnt: Generic premium positioning is not enough. Private label is gaining with younger shoppers, value retailers are leaning into frozen, and e-grocery platforms are training consumers to compare against low-priced private-label alternatives.
agency_brief.recommendation: Tighten Real Dough around proof: real sourdough process, Wisconsin origin, clean ingredient substantiation, stronger value-per-meal logic, and complete digital shelf content. Make every claim buyer-defensible and shopper-obvious.
agency_brief.competitive_context: This week’s intel points to three pressures: private-label pizza opportunity, value-priced frozen expansion at Dollar General and Amazon Grocery, and higher execution standards across Kroger, DoorDash/Circana, Natural Grocers and retail-broker services.
